rows.name: Eduardo Gallardo Maldonado
rows.stageSourceTitle: Alien Pleads Guilty to Illegally Voting in 2024 General Election
sentences: PHILADELPHIA – United States Attorney David Metcalf announced that Eduardo Gallardo Maldonado, 66, a Mexican citizen and lawful permanent resident of the United States who has been residing in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, entered a plea of guilty today before United States Magistrate Judge Elizabeth L. Toplin to one count of voting as an alien.
The defendant is scheduled to be sentenced on February 9 and faces a maximum of one year of imprisonment, one year of supervised release, and a $100,000 fine.

rows.name: Khalwinder Singh Bhengura
rows.stageSourceTitle: Federal jury finds Indian national guilty of unlawfully voting in 2024 Presidential Election
sentences: FORT WORTH, Texas – United States Attorney for the Northern District of Texas Ryan Raybould announced that a federal jury convicted Indian national Khalwinder Singh Bhengura of voting by an alien in a federal election and making a false claim of U.S. citizenship to register to vote. After a two-day trial before U.S. District Judge Mark T. Pittman, the jury deliberated for several hours and returned its verdict Oct. 27.
